deltas.description: Production change: pending-source reads and term preparation move outside the Room writer transaction. The bounded commit rechecks pending membership and exact nullable source contents under the writer before modifying FTS or clearing pending; stale prepared work retries.

runtime_continuity_boundary: V3 performance/runtime results keep their v3 source and APK identity. V4 changes production indexing behavior, so v3 5/5 is not v4 search/index correctness or performance evidence. New v4 validation and relevant paired performance remain required; this task ran none.
